name: LifecycleState
title: Issuer lifecycle state of a document reference
description: The lifecycle state the issuer's lifecycle events establish for the issuance this reference represents, where it does not contradict DocumentReference.status. Values: issued, replaced-for-update, replaced-for-correction. Never withdrawn: see the withdrawal modifier extension.
